_meta.description: Carta OAuth 2.0 client-credentials RE-MINT. Carta has NO refresh-token grant — access tokens expire hourly and are re-minted by re-running grant_type=client_credentials with the app's client_id/client_secret. No refresh_token is returned. The stored refresh_secret_ref therefore holds the client-credentials SECRET (not an OAuth refresh token). Doc-derived; tokens are placeholders.
_meta.source: doc:https://developers.carta.com/docs/authentication (OAuth2; supports authorization_code + client_credentials, NO refresh_token grant; access tokens ~3600s, re-mint via client_credentials; response access_token/expires_in/token_type/scope)
